title: Components V2 Migration
content: The Joinly Components V2 migration is now complete! 🎉
Thank you for your patience while we worked through the migration. We've made a number of updates and improvements across Joinly.
What's changed?
Components V2 — Joinly's messages have been fully migrated to the new system.
Thumbnail removed — The Thumbnail option has been removed from Welcome/Goodbye messages, and any existing thumbnail configurations have been automatically deleted.
GIF support — You can now upload GIFs directly from your device in the Welcome/Goodbye editor.
Improved messages — Welcome, goodbye, logs, polls, status updates and other messages have received various layout and reliability improvements.
Bug fixes — Several smaller issues and permission/error handling problems have also been addressed.
⚠️ Found an issue?
If you notice any errors or something isn't working as expected, please let us know in our Support Server
Please include a screenshot or details about what happened where possible.
Thank you again for your patience and for using Joinly! 💜

title: Member Tracking
content: NEW: Join & Leave Logs
Joinly now lets you automatically log members joining and leaving your server.
Completely FREE — no Premium required.
Configure your logging channel with /join-logs and Joinly will automatically send detailed member activity logs, including:
• Member information
• User ID
• Account creation date
• Account age
• Server member count
• Join/leave timestamps
• Time spent in the server
How to enable:
/join-logs
You can also enable, disable, or view your current configuration at any time.
Available now for all Joinly servers.

title: Domain Change
content: Joinly has officially moved from Netlify to Vercel! 🚀

This decision wasn't an easy one, but it will help keep costs lower for the developers in the long run. Since Joinly is a passion project and isn't generating any income, reducing unnecessary expenses is important.
Everything you know stays the same. Same website, same features, just a new domain.
